image_description: A tall, dark-colored maypole stands in a grassy park setting with bare trees in the background. Colorful ribbons (yellow, blue, red, green, purple) stream down from a floral wreath at the top. Several young children in light-colored clothing are holding the ends of the ribbons, appearing to dance or prepare to dance around the pole.
